name: agent-orchestrator
description: Create and queue Agent Orchestrator tasks from any project via the orchestrator's MCP endpoint. Claude Code handles OAuth (DCR + PKCE) automatically on first use — no static credentials live in this plugin.

orchestrator_url.title: Orchestrator URL
orchestrator_url.description: Browser-reachable base URL of the running Agent Orchestrator instance. The plugin's MCP server uses this to reach the orchestrator's /mcp endpoint. Example: http://localhost:8081 for a local docker-compose install on the same machine, or https://orchestrator.example.com for a remote deployment behind TLS termination.
